name: Goblin Jubilee
text:
Chaos fills a 20-foot burst within 120 feet. All creatures in the area takes max(3,(3 + floor((@actor.level - 10/ 3))))d6 fire,max(3,(3 + floor((@actor.level - 10/ 3))))d6 sonic damage and must attempt a Fortitude save save. Every 3 levels, the fire damage and sonic damage each increase by 1d6. You can expend 2 versatile vials instead of 1 to increase the fire and sonic damage by 1d6 each, or by 2d6 each at 16th level.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Dazzled and Deafened until the end of its next turn and takes half damage.

Failure The creature is dazzled and deafened for 1 minute and takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature is Blinded for 1 round, dazzled and deafened for 1 minute, and takes double damage.
